command:
export THREADS=16
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
THREADS="${THREADS:-16}"
REF=GRCh38_full_analysis_set_plus_decoy_hla.fa

echo "== inputs: the published GRCh38 bwa index + one complete sequencing run =="
for f in $REF.alt $REF.amb $REF.ann $REF.bwt $REF.pac $REF.sa SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz; do
  test -s "$f" || { echo "missing $f"; exit 1; }
done
du -ch $REF.* SRR062634_*.gz 2>/dev/null | awk '/total/{print "  staged:", $1}'

echo "== align: 24.1M read pairs against all of GRCh38, -t $THREADS =="
T0=$(date +%s)
# Both readers below consume to EOF, so nothing SIGPIPEs the writer. gzip keeps the
# intermediate at ~1/4 size for the trip through S3 -- the data path is the real cost here.
bwa mem -t "$THREADS" -R '@RG\tID:SRR062634\tSM:HG00096\tPL:ILLUMINA' \
    "$REF" SRR062634_1.filt.fastq.gz SRR062634_2.filt.fastq.gz 2> bwa.log \
  | tee >(gzip -1 > aln.sam.gz) \
  | awk '!/^@/ { n++; if ($3!="*") m++ } END { printf "%d\t%d\n", n, m }' > counts.tsv
T1=$(date +%s); WALL=$(( T1 - T0 ))
read -r NREC NMAP < counts.tsv

echo "== was the reference used ALT-aware? =="
ALTN=$(awk '/ALT contigs/{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="read"){print $(i+1); exit}}' bwa.log)
ALTN=${ALTN:-0}
printf 'alt_contigs_read\t%s   (assert >0 -- the analysis-set reference is meant to be used\n' "$ALTN"
printf 'alt_contigs_read\t     WITH its .alt; without it bwa logs "read 0 ALT contigs" and emits\n'
printf 'alt_contigs_read\t     ~425k FEWER records, silently, at exit 0)\n'
test "$ALTN" -gt 0 || { echo "read 0 ALT contigs -- .alt missing or unread"; exit 1; }

echo "== the output is real: gzip integrity, size, and the counts =="
gzip -t aln.sam.gz || { echo "aln.sam.gz is corrupt"; exit 1; }
GZ=$(stat -c%s aln.sam.gz)
PCT=$(awk -v m="$NMAP" -v n="$NREC" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", 100*m/n}')
{
printf 'bwa_version\t%s\n' "$(awk '/^Version/{v=$2} END{print v}' <(bwa 2>&1) )"
printf 'threads\t%s\n' "$THREADS"
printf 'align_wall_s\t%s\n' "$WALL"
printf 'sam_records\t%s   (assert 48817006 -- EXACT, and cross-validated: the same count came\n' "$NREC"
printf 'sam_records\t     back from a lith mount of the published prefix and from a local copy\n'
printf 'sam_records\t     including .alt, on different boxes)\n' 
printf 'mapped_records\t%s\n' "$NMAP"
printf 'pct_mapped\t%s   (assert >= 99.9)\n' "$PCT"
printf 'aln_sam_gz_bytes\t%s\n' "$GZ"
printf 'reads_per_sec\t%s\n' "$(awk -v n="$NREC" -v w="$WALL" 'BEGIN{printf "%.0f", n/w}')"
} | tee smoke-check.txt

test "$NREC" = "48817006" || { echo "record count $NREC != 48817006 -- input, .alt, or version changed"; exit 1; }
awk -v p="$PCT" 'BEGIN{ if (p+0 < 99.9) { printf "only %s%% mapped\n", p; exit 1 } }'
test "$GZ" -gt 1000000000 || { echo "aln.sam.gz is only $GZ bytes"; exit 1; }
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
